heading: Privacy policy
metaDescription: How the JIE website treats contact links, WhatsApp messages and analytics. A static brochure site with no contact forms and no advertising cookies.
intro: This is the website of Jyotiba Instruments Enterprises (JIE), a calibration, repair and sales business. This page explains what the site itself does — and does not do — with information.

items.title: The short version
body: The site is a static brochure for the business. It has no user accounts, stores nothing you type in a database, and does not sell, rent or share data with advertisers. The only interactive contact happens where you choose to contact us: WhatsApp, a phone call or an email.

items.title: Contacting JIE
body: WhatsApp, call and email buttons open WhatsApp, your phone app or your email app with contact details and, in most cases, a ready-made message. What you type and send goes directly to JIE through those channels. Once you write to us, we have your contact details and your message — we use them to answer your enquiry and nothing else.
The address, phone and GSTIN details shown on the contact page are the business's own published contact details.

items.title: What the site does not do
body: There are no contact forms on the site, so no form data exists. Nothing is installed from social-network companies, no behaviour of yours is profiled, and the site does not set cookies of its own.

items.title: Analytics (only if enabled)
body: If website analytics have been enabled, a small script loads that records page views and link taps — for example that a catalogue was opened or a WhatsApp button tapped — together with basic browser and country information. Analytics are never required for the site to work: with the ID unset, no such script loads at all.

items.title: Changes
body: If the website changes, this page is updated to match. Questions are welcome through the details on the contact page.
